faq.headline: Everything you wanted to know.
faq.subheadline: Straight answers to the questions agents ask before they partner with us. Don't see yours? Just ask.

stillHaveQuestions.heading: Still have questions?
stillHaveQuestions.body: Reach out directly — we usually reply within an hour during business hours.

items.question: Is the Partner Plan really free? What's the catch?
items.answer: There's no catch. The Partner Plan has zero monthly fee because we earn our income when we close mortgage loans. When your buyers and sellers close with us as their lender, that's how we make our money — so giving you a free CRM and free partnership makes sense for both of us. You only pay for SMS and email usage at cost (typically $5–15/month for an active agent).

items.question: Do I have to use you exclusively as my lender?
items.answer: No. We're not asking for exclusivity. We just ask that you give us a fair shot — send us your buyers and let us prove we can close faster, communicate better, and serve them well. If we earn it, we become your preferred lender naturally. If we don't, you keep your other relationships. No contracts, no penalties.

items.question: What states can you lend in?
items.answer: We're licensed in 7 states: Utah, Idaho, Nevada, California, Texas, Florida, and Colorado. If your client is buying in any of these states, we can help. We're actively expanding to additional states — if your market isn't on the list yet, let us know and we'll keep you posted.

items.question: How fast can you really pre-approve a buyer?
items.answer: Standard pre-approval turnaround is 24 hours from when we receive a complete application. For straightforward files, we've issued pre-approvals same-day. We'll always tell you upfront if a file needs more time — for example, self-employed buyers or unique credit situations may need 48–72 hours to structure properly.

items.question: I already use a CRM. Can yours integrate or replace it?
items.answer: Most agents who try ours end up replacing their old CRM — not because they have to, but because they prefer it. Our system includes lead capture, automated follow-up across SMS/email/social, calendar booking, pipeline tracking, and ready-to-send real estate campaigns. If you'd rather integrate, we can connect to most major platforms (Follow Up Boss, KvCORE, BoomTown, etc.) on the Professional and Advanced plans.

items.question: Do you really have bilingual support? My clients need Spanish.
items.answer: Yes — fully bilingual, end to end. Loan officers, processors, and closing coordinators all speak both English and Spanish fluently. Your Spanish-speaking clients will be served in their language at every stage, from first call to closing table. This is one of the things realtors most often tell us sets us apart.

items.question: Are you actually licensed? Who am I working with?
items.answer: Yes. Pedro Lira is a licensed mortgage loan originator (NMLS #318973) with Xpert Home Lending (NMLS #2179191), an Equal Housing Lender. You can verify our license at any time on the NMLS Consumer Access portal at nmlsconsumeraccess.org. We follow all federal and state lending regulations — you and your clients are working with a fully compliant, accountable team.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Book a 15-minute intro call. We'll walk you through how the Partner Plan works, show you the CRM, and answer any remaining questions. No commitment, no credit card, no pressure — just a conversation to see if we're a good fit. If we are, you can start sending us deals the same week.
